tasks.title: Design doc: seed offsets, particle/emitter format, wind field container, weather state schema, sky LUT params, cloud approach, gate thresholds, ownership+executor map, mega-bump protocol; + quiet-machine release perf re-bless
tasks.prompt: Opus inline (orchestrator-driven). Finalize design-decisions.md: replace every 'pin at review' placeholder with a concrete value (particle pool capacity, wind cell size/layers/budget ms, sky LUT resolutions, atmosphere params, all gate ms thresholds). Bind ALL critique resolutions F1-F10 (single-commit mega-bump + re-validation; explicit emitter-descriptor snapshot surface + one-way render->sim ban; GPU-timer budgets not the worldgen lane; dedicated clear-sky scenarios so existing gate premises hold; scoped sky rewrite no-froxel; tick-derived render-side season; bounded-state endurance; named 5b downstream readers). PREREQUISITE: capture the post-iteration-4-trio quiet-machine release baseline via .forge/scripts/run-release-perf-lane.ps1 -Bless (carried debt) so all 5a perf budgets gate honestly; if the machine is noise-contaminated, record that and defer to a quiet window but do not block A-wave start on a noisy bless.

tasks.title: Instanced GPU particle pool + ParticlePass (after skybox) + deterministic emitter schedule; magical_particles re-homes
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. Instanced fixed-capacity persistent-mapped particle pool (reuse the T-I4-16 persistent-mapped pool pattern — NOT compute/transform-feedback in v1, research section 2); new ParticlePass slotted AFTER SkyboxPass, reads G-buffer depth for soft-particle fade + collision, blends into the lit HDR target; lit by sun/ambient + nearest point lights. magical_particles.{vert,frag,geom} re-homes onto the framework. Emitter format = game data in data/common/particles/ (rate/lifetime/velocity/size/color curves + .ltex array refs + blend mode). CRITICAL determinism surface (critique F2): the ParticleEmitterDeterminism gate snapshots the EMITTER DESCRIPTOR SET ONLY {id,type,origin-region,spawn-rate,RNG seed,enable} at a fixed tick, byte-equal across 2 runs; particle motion/arrays are render-only, NEVER hashed, NEVER snapshotted. One-way rule: particles must not write any sim/world_hash input. Gates: ParticleEmitterDeterminism (descriptor snapshot + visual capture) + a ParticlePass GPU-timer budget under the pinned threshold (release-lane render-submission assertion, NOT the worldgen lane). The emitter-creation API is public + stable (5b waterfall spray / B2 precip / B3 scorch consume it). Expose per-pass GPU timer for ParticlePass.

tasks.title: Deterministic 2.5D wind vector field on the 30Hz tick in a generalized Field container; +11 seed; wind sub-hash (world_hash mega-bump #1)
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. APPEND seed offset +11 (wind) FIRST, append-only registry. Coarse 2.5D vector field (cell size/layers/budget per design-decisions) on the 30Hz tick; base large-scale direction from seed+11 low-freq FastNoise batch sampled by tick-time + a hook for storm perturbations (consumed by B1); DeterministicMath ONLY (no libm trig/exp in the tick path); pass SimDeterminismLint. Factor the storage/iteration/snapshot/sub-hash plumbing as a generalized Field so a scalar Aetheric field reuses it in iteration 6 (critique F5: MINIMUM shared surface only — document the interface + share the snapshot/hash path; do NOT build a finished generic template or a second consumer). Add a 'wind' sub-hash to the world_hash artifact. THIS IS world_hash MEGA-BUMP #1 (critique F1 / design-decisions section 2): in the SAME commit, re-run + re-bless the heavy-mode save/load/resim oracle, ReplayRoundtrip, ReplayDivergence, LockstepLoopback, LockstepFaultInjection, and log old->new world_hash. PROVE the wind update is DeterministicMath-clean BEFORE folding into the hash; if unexpectedly non-neutral or replay breaks, STOP and report. Gate: WindFieldDeterminism (seed -> N-tick wind-field hash equal across 2 runs). Public SampleWind(worldPos) API stable (B1 advection, B2 rain slant, 5b foliage consume it). Per-tick budget under the pinned ms.

tasks.title: Server-authoritative storm-cell weather over biome base; +12 seed; weather state in world_hash (mega-bump #2); weather_system.frag graduates to sim-driven
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. APPEND seed offset +12 (weather/storm) FIRST. Base pressure (seed+12) x biome temperature/humidity (iter-4 climate channels) -> region category (clear/overcast/rain/snow/fog); discrete storm cells spawned on a seeded schedule (no wall-clock, no std::random in the tick path), advected by the A2 wind field; precipitation intensity field; DeterministicMath only; SimDeterminismLint pass. weather_system.frag graduates from the set_weather debug overlay to sim-driven uniforms fed from REPLICATED state. STATE in world_hash 'weather' slot = region category + storm cells (pos/intensity/velocity) + precip field + (B3 will add) strike schedule; the overlay/streaks/wetness are RENDER-ONLY (critique F2 one-way rule). State BOUNDED (critique F9): storm-cell count cap, flat precip-field memory. THIS IS world_hash MEGA-BUMP #2 (same single-commit re-validation protocol as A2). Gate: WeatherVisual EXTENDED — weather state-hash stable across resim/replay + baseline-vs-weather sky-luma drop + streak gradient driven by real state. CRITICAL premise guard (critique F4): storms run ONLY in a dedicated weather scenario with clear-sky control phases — do NOT enable storms inside SkyboxVisual/PlayerView/TimeOfDaySweep. Public weather-state query API stable (B3, 5b ecology/audio consume it).

tasks.title: Wind-advected rain/snow + splash/spray through the particle framework
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. Rain/snow emitters created from replicated weather state via the A1 framework, wind-advected so rain SLANTS in storms (sample the A2 wind field), splash/spray emitters on G-buffer depth impact. Emitter descriptors deterministic (snapshot surface from A1); particle motion render-only. Depends on A1 framework + A2 wind + B1 weather state. Gate: precipitation present + slant-responds-to-wind in a weather capture; ParticlePass GPU-timer stays under the (now precip-loaded) budget. No new world_hash content.

tasks.title: Deterministic strike schedule (+13) in world_hash; render bolt + lighting-pass light pulse; thunder via existing audio propagation
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. APPEND seed offset +13 (lightning schedule) FIRST. SIM-side: storm cells above an intensity threshold schedule strike events (tick, world pos, magnitude) from a seed+13 deterministic RNG stream; strikes are WORLD EVENTS in the 'weather' world_hash slot (replayable, identical for every player); DeterministicMath only. RENDER-side: seeded branching bolt (midpoint-displacement seeded from the event), a 1-to-few-frame full-scene light pulse injected through the LIGHTING PASS at the strike position, scorch via A1 emitters. AUDIO: thunder via the EXISTING AudioPropagationSystem with distance-correct delay (distance/343) — READ AudioPropagationSystem.h FIRST to confirm a delayed positional one-shot exists; reuse it; only a THIN additive hook if missing (NOT new propagation machinery); null-audio gates stay green; the visual gate does NOT depend on audio (critique F8). Iteration-6 fire-ignition hook NOTED in a comment, NOT built. Gate: WeatherVisual asserts a captured strike frame shows the frame-mean luminance pulse (spike vs neighbor frames) + bolt pixels (bright thin high-gradient structure) — the photography timing shot. Strike schedule folds into the existing 'weather' sub-hash (re-validate replay/lockstep in the commit).

tasks.title: Hillaire-2020 scattering LUTs replace the authored gradient; coherent sun/sky/ambient/fog; analytic aerial perspective
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. Hillaire 2020 precomputed LUTs (transmittance ~256x64, multi-scatter ~32x32, sky-view ~200x100 per design-decisions) replace the authored gradient in enhanced_skybox.frag; sun/sky/ambient/fog all read the same transmittance so low-sun pinks/purples/oranges EMERGE from Rayleigh/Mie. KEEP the u_skyDayFactor seam as the night-darkening envelope + star/aurora layers. Analytic aerial-perspective term in the lighting pass (wire the dormant volumetric_lighting.frag / extend lighting_pass.frag) — NO froxel volume (deferred, critique F6). SCOPE STOP at 'three LUTs + analytic aerial'. Calibrate atmosphere params so noon luminance lands inside the existing TimeOfDaySweep noon band where achievable; any band move is a SINGLE deliberate logged re-bless. RenderHealth resource-registry entries for the LUTs + startup precompute cost in render telemetry; RenderHealth re-bless deliberate. Render-only — NOTHING enters world_hash. Gates: TimeOfDaySweep gains dawn/dusk HUE-BAND assertions (sky r/b ratio); SkyboxVisual asserts low-sun-angle scattering palette emergence (CLEAR-SKY atmosphere — premise guard F4); sky-precompute + aerial-term GPU-timer budgets.

tasks.title: Tick-derived long-period season time scale: sun path, day length, palettes; season-sweep gate
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. Season phase = PURE FUNCTION OF TICK COUNT (integer epoch math; DeterministicMath for sun-path trig) — NEVER wall-clock, NEVER a free-running float accumulator (critique F7). Drives sun path, day length, biome material/foliage palette selection. RENDER-DERIVED — computed from the authoritative tick on the client; adds NOTHING to world_hash. Gate: TimeOfDaySweep extends to a SEASON SWEEP (per-season sun-path + palette bands) on a clear-sky atmosphere. Reuse update_time_of_day in RenderPipeline.cpp (~line 3103) as the integration seam.

tasks.title: Wind-advected 2.5D coverage clouds + real cast shadows (lighting-pass projection); tier-2 raymarch deferred
tasks.prompt: Opus agent. 2.5D wind-advected coverage field (f(noise, wind offset, weather, biome)) scrolled by the A2 large-scale wind direction so clouds visibly move with the wind; landscape-distance fluffy imposters. REAL cast shadows: project the coverage field and sample it in the LIGHTING PASS, directSun *= (1 - cloudShadow(worldPos)), yielding crawling terrain shadows. Prefer a LOW-RES coverage/shadow texture + cheap sample (critique F3); if the per-fragment sample exceeds budget, fall back to a coarser projection rather than ship a regression. RENDER-ONLY, pure function of replicated weather state + tick + wind; one-way (nothing reads clouds back into world_hash, critique F2). TIER 2 volumetric Nubis raymarch is iteration 6 — OUT OF SCOPE. Gate: CloudShadow (partly-cloudy fixture, NOT overcast — premise guard F4: moving cast-shadow signature = luminance delta in a fixed terrain ROI as a shadow edge crosses) + cloud layer present in SkyboxVisual; cloud-shadow GPU-timer budget.
